agentic.summary: Agent offered a refund before completing required full verification (major). Minor conduct issue for abrupt/unprofessional language. No personal data, promises or escalation violations found in the provided transcript excerpts.

findings.quote: I can offer a refund now. Just make sure you can customer support immediately to get shipping label for return
findings.explanation: The agent offers a refund (an account action that requires full verification) while the transcript only shows the account being pulled (system turn 14) and 'Identity verification in progress ...' (system turn 15). The policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID) before refunds/returns. There is no evidence in the transcript that the required verification (username and email) was completed before the refund was offered.
The agent's single-word "Hey!" is abrupt and can be perceived as curt or unprofessional. The policy requires courteous tone; a curt or dismissive tone is a minor conduct violation.

full.summary: Audit of agent behaviour: two major violations found (promises and verification). No personal data, escalation, or conduct violations detected.

findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the action as complete ('Done' at turn 31) while the transcript does not show full verification required for refunds/returns. Although the agent asked for and received full name, account ID and order ID (turns 7, 11-13) and the account was pulled up (system turn 14), the policy requires username and email address in addition to order ID for refunds/returns. There is no evidence the agent collected the customer's username or email before the refund (system log at turn 29 shows a $49 refund), so an account/order action was completed without the required full verification (major).

findings.quote: No worries, I'll issue you a $20 discount as a courtesy and refund the Guess jeans immediately.
findings.explanation: The agent promised a $20 discount and an immediate refund at turn 9. The policy forbids promising compensation or discounts that are not in the procedures; this is an unapproved courtesy discount and a guaranteed immediate refund outside documented procedures (major).

rag.summary: Audit of provided conversation excerpts: one major verification violation (agent offered a refund before full identity verification was completed). No other policy violations found.
